decisions.rationale: Admin wants to capture loss reasons but not block the workflow

decisions.decision: Esfriando = 5+ days since last STAGE CHANGE (not last edit), only flags cards in Contatado
decisions.rationale: Simpler to compute (existing stage-entry timestamp concept), matches admin's mental model of 'stuck in the funnel'
